## Accuracy checklist (required for any content change)

- [ ] Every regulatory/framework specific (article numbers, deadlines, thresholds, control counts, dates) is either verified against an official source or explicitly hedged with "verify against the official text"
- [ ] Official source(s) supporting the change are linked in this PR description
- [ ] The touched pack's `## Primary sources` links still resolve
- [ ] `Last reviewed:` date updated to the current YYYY-MM in every context pack touched
- [ ] No verbatim licensed standard text (ISO, PCI DSS, etc.) — summaries and structure only
- [ ] Content is provider-neutral (no AI-vendor syntax outside `docs/integrations/`)

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_skills.py` passes locally
